## Background

When treatments are multivariate — such as continuous dose vectors or multiple
binary arms — the standard BCF model extends to:

$$
Y_i = \mu(X_i) + \tau(X_i)^\top Z_i + \epsilon_i
$$

where $Z_i \in \mathbb{R}^p$ and $\tau(X_i) \in \mathbb{R}^p$ is a vector of
covariate-varying treatment effects.
